documentationIndex.title: MealPrep Documentation Index
documentationIndex.description: Complete documentation for the MealPrep application - a React Native meal planning, grocery management, and nutritional tracking application built with Expo and TypeScript.

file.name: PROJECT_OVERVIEW.xml
file.title: Project Overview
file.description: High-level overview of the entire project including architecture, features, technology stack, project structure, and conventions used throughout the codebase.
file.contains: - Project metadata and purpose - Key features with file references - System architecture patterns - Data flow diagrams - Technology stack and dependencies - Project directory structure - Build and run instructions - Coding conventions and naming standards

file.name: STORES.xml
file.title: State Management Stores
file.description: Comprehensive documentation of all global state management providers and hooks. Includes profileStore, ingredientsStore, historyStore, and groceriesStore.
file.contains:
- profileStore: User profile and settings management * UserProfile type definition * Profile CRUD operations * Theme preference handling * Async persistence with AsyncStorage
- ingredientsStore: Meal planning state * Meal → Section → Item hierarchical structure * Complete CRUD operations for all levels * Proportional quantity calculation algorithm * Meal reset and content clearing * Item toggle functionality
- historyStore: Meal history tracking * HistoryEntry and HistoryIngredient types * Meal logging with timestamps * History entry CRUD operations * Newest-first ordering
- groceriesStore: Shopping list management * Custom hook implementation (not a provider) * GroceryItem type definition * Add, update, remove, and toggle operations * Clear checked and clear all functionality

file.name: COMPONENTS_AND_HOOKS.xml
file.title: Components and Hooks
file.description: Documentation for shared UI components and custom React hooks used across the application. Includes PanelContext, ConfirmationModal, and useTheme hook.
file.contains:
- PanelContext: Global modal/panel management system * PanelProvider for wrapping app * Panel open/close/toggle operations * Panel data passing mechanism * usePanels hook for accessing panel context
- ConfirmationModal: Reusable confirmation dialog component * Standard and destructive modes * Customizable button text * Theme-aware styling (light/dark) * Icon support with material icons * Responsive design
- useTheme: Theme provider hook * Light/dark mode support * System preference detection * User theme override options * Theme color object structure * Automatic theme updates

file.name: DATA_AND_CONFIGURATION.xml
file.title: Data and Configuration
file.description: Static data files and configuration constants including ingredients database, color palettes, typography, and spacing definitions.
file.contains:
- ingredients.json: Comprehensive ingredient database * 9 ingredient categories * 100+ pre-configured ingredients * Default quantities and units per ingredient * Category structure with icons * Usage in ingredient picker
- app/styles/global_style.ts: App design system * Color palette (primary, secondary, light/dark themes) * Typography/font definitions (Epilogue family) * Spacing system (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) * StyleSheet definitions * Theme-specific color mappings
- constants/theme.ts: Expo theme configuration * Platform-specific colors * Light and dark mode definitions * Platform-specific fonts (iOS, Android, Web) * Tint colors and icon colors
- app.json: Expo configuration * App metadata and versioning * Platform-specific settings * Plugin configuration * Permissions and capabilities

reference.name: ID Generation
reference.pattern: Format: `${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}` Used in: GroceryItem, HistoryEntry, custom ingredients, selected ingredients Prevents collisions in rapid creation scenarios
Format: `custom_${Date.now()}_${random}` or `${parent}_${Date.now()}_${random}` Usage: Custom items that need categorization

dataFlow.step1: Component calls store hook (useProfile, useIngredients, etc.)
dataFlow.step2: Hook provides state and mutation functions
dataFlow.step3: Component calls mutation function (addItem, updateProfile, etc.)

persistencePattern.step: 1. On mount: Load data from AsyncStorage in useEffect
5. Skip first state change after load (hasEverSavedRef)
6. Auto-save every subsequent state change to AsyncStorage
7. Use alive flag to prevent state updates on unmounted components

naming.convention: kebab-case for multi-word files (panel-context.tsx), snake_case for styles (global_style.ts)

codeStyle.convention: Use React Context API with AsyncStorage for state persistence
Implement hydration pattern with isHydratingRef and hasEverSavedRef
Use immutable updates with spread operator
Arrow functions for components and functions

structuring.convention: Store files: Types → Context → Constants → Functions → Provider → Hook
Component files: Props → Component → Styles → Exports
Data files: Static JSON structure matching TypeScript types

issue.name: Data not persisting
issue.solution: Check that component is within provider wrapper and useEffect dependencies include state

issue.name: Theme not updating
issue.cause: useTheme hook not re-rendering on profile change
issue.solution: Ensure useProfile is called before useTheme, check profile dependency in effect

issue.name: Modal not appearing
issue.cause: Panel not opened or PanelProvider not at root
issue.solution: Wrap app with PanelProvider and call openPanel with correct panelId

issue.name: Proportional quantity showing NaN
issue.cause: Division by zero when no items checked
issue.solution: Check guard clause in calculateProportionalQty for totalWeight === 0

policy.rule: Update documentation when adding new stores

Update documentation when changing color scheme
Document new custom hooks in COMPONENTS_AND_HOOKS.xml
Document new ingredients by updating DATA_AND_CONFIGURATION.xml
Keep version consistent across all documentation files
